# Nesting and containers

1. ordered parent
   - reported: nested bullet under an ordered item? yes
   - reported: second nested bullet

> Quoted block.
>
> - reported: bullet inside a quote
>   1. ordered inside a quote
>      - reported: nested bullet two levels into a quote

    - indented code, not a list

Tab indentation counts as four columns:

	- indented code via tab, not a list

- reported: top level bullet after indented code

  continued paragraph inside the list item

- [ ] reported: task list item
- [x] reported: checked task item

123456789. a nine-digit ordered marker is valid

1234567890. ten digits is not an ordered marker
- reported: so this bullet is still tracked normally
